Real Estate + Property Management + Interior Design

Dominique Duncan-Nelson

Real Estate, Property Management, and Interior Design
Under One Roof

Dominique Duncan-Nelson is a Chatsworth-based REALTOR® with The Rise Team at Real Brokerage, guiding clients through every step of buying, selling, leasing, and managing property across the San Fernando Valley.

Dominique helps buyers, sellers, renters, and investors navigate the Valley's real estate market — and specializes in leasing and furnished property management for Airbnb and short-term rental owners. Backed by 7+ years of property management experience and a background in interior design, she brings the same eye for detail to every home, listing, and investment property she touches.
